items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He let Hal Williams go. He let organ go. That was when I joined.

ctx.x: That’s the Indian thing. That’s Badal. Here, now, Badal starts with me with McLaughlin with My Goal’s Beyond. Then he goes with me On the Corner. He’s in the band when I start with Miles. He was in the first three or four months before he let the sitar – and he let Hal Williams go. He let organ go. That was when I joined. Indian music. Look, it’s . . .
